description: CrossBridge AI 优化前后对比案例（8 组）：原表达 vs 优化表达，评分由系统实时分析计算

pairs.title: 催款邮件
pairs.original: We have not received your payment. You must pay us immediately.
pairs.optimized:
Dear Mr. Chen,

We noticed that payment for invoice INV-2025-01 (due last Friday) has not yet reached us. Could you kindly check on the status? If there is any issue, we will be happy to work with you on a solution.
pairs.risk_focus: 命令式语气与直接施压

pairs.title: 报价谈判
pairs.original: Your price is unacceptable. We will find another supplier.
pairs.optimized: We value our cooperation. However, the current price exceeds our budget. Could you kindly share how the price is structured? We would like to explore a solution that works for both sides.
pairs.risk_focus: 威胁式施压与关闭谈判

pairs.title: 会议反驳
pairs.original: You are wrong. My plan is better.
pairs.optimized: I see the merits of your approach. Let me share an alternative angle that could complement it, and we can compare the two together.

pairs.title: 延误责任
pairs.original: The delay is not our fault. Our supplier made the mistake.
pairs.optimized: We sincerely apologize for the delay. We are working closely with our supply chain to resolve it, and we will provide a confirmed schedule within 48 hours.

pairs.title: 跟进质问
pairs.original: Why haven't you replied to our emails?
pairs.optimized: I wanted to follow up on my previous messages regarding the quotation. When you have a moment, could you let us know your thoughts?

pairs.title: 压价威胁
pairs.original: Give us a 15% discount or we walk away.
pairs.optimized: Given our projected order volume of 20,000 units, could you kindly consider a 15% adjustment? We believe this would support a long-term partnership.

pairs.title: 方案拒绝
pairs.optimized: Thank you for sharing your proposal. We see potential in some aspects. However, the timeline may need further discussion. Could we explore adjustments together?

pairs.title: 投诉指责
pairs.original: Your products are terrible. We want a full refund now.
pairs.optimized: We have identified quality issues with batch #102 received on May 10. This has affected our operations. Could you please investigate and advise on how you plan to resolve this, including compensation options?
